- Reviewed webhook signature code in webhook.rs, finding three issues.
- verify_signature used == for HMAC digest comparison (timing-attack vulnerable); switched to constant-time compare.
- Timestamp check accepted any age; now rejects requests older than 300 seconds.
- Missing X-Hub-Signature-256 header returned Ok(()) instead of an error, letting unsigned requests pass; now returns an error (critical fix).
- All three fixed in commit e485795 with three passing tests covering each case.
